name: merge-policy
description: Answers permission checks for `gh pr merge` commands from a rule file (~/.claude/merge-policy.json): allows a single merge only when the PR is open, not a draft, mergeable, green and the flags match the rule; denies with a clear reason when a condition fails; makes a person approve every other merge, so auto mode cannot approve one alone; passes every other command through. Inert without the rule file.
